label: prf:meson-em-sinh-closed-form
title: Proof of meson em sinh closed form
html:
Proof. Proof of meson em sinh closed form

Proof

The four expressions are equal as rational functions of q over any field with q \ne 0. Starting from the leftmost, expand \hbar_q^2 = (1 - q^{-1})^2 = 1 - 2 q^{-1} + q^{-2}, so

  1 + \hbar_q - \tfrac{1}{2}\hbar_q^2
  = 1 + (1 - q^{-1}) - \tfrac{1}{2}(1 - 2 q^{-1} + q^{-2})
  = \tfrac{3}{2} - \tfrac{1}{2} q^{-2}
  = \frac{3 - q^{-2}}{2}.

Multiplying numerator and denominator by q^2 gives (3 q^2 - 1)/(2 q^2). \square
